clips.title: The story
paras: In Thousand Needles, Steelsnap's Rib marks the end of a feared hyena's reign. Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff wants the bone brought to Hunter Rise as proof that Steelsnap has been slain.

Tauren hunts often seek food, honor, or harmony with nature. Steelsnap is different. The alpha hyena roams the canyon floor south of Camp E'thok in Thousand Needles, terrorizing peaceful wildlife and rallying lesser predators to bloodshed. Hunt master Melor Stonehoof, on Hunter Rise, marks Steelsnap for death. He asks for the hyena's rib as proof the tyrant is slain and the canyon cleansed of its blight.
